name: amar-bari
description: AmarBari (আমার বাড়ি) — property & rent management platform

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix e2e install
scripts.db:reset: cd server && npx prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run infra:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix server run test && npm --prefix client run test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
